title: Concept: XPath error echoing the expression
description: An XPath exception that repeats the expression it evaluated in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The echo shows how the search is built from input, which is the response an attacker uses to shape a blind injection against the XML store.
applicability: Deployments that render an XPath exception that repeats the expression it evaluated into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The echo shows how the search is built from input, which is the response an attacker uses to shape a blind injection against the XML store.
